people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”
translations.bsb: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
translations.kjv: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
translations.asv: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Make ye no ado; for his life is in him.
